passages.text: Then Moses summoned all Israel and said to them: Hear, O Israel, the statutes and ordinances that I declare in your hearing this day. Learn them and observe them carefully.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses called all the people of Israel together.
Moses spoke to them.
Moses said, "Listen, Israel."
Moses said, "Hear the statutes and the ordinances."
Moses said, "I am speaking these laws to you today."
Moses said, "Learn these laws."
Moses said, "Keep these laws."
Moses said, "Do them."
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם שְׁמַ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ הַחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י דֹּבֵ֥ר בְּאָזְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.
passages.sermon: The LORD is our God.\r\nThe LORD made a covenant with us.\r\nThe LORD made this covenant at Horeb.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת עִמָּ֛נוּ בְּרִ֖ית בְּחֹרֵֽב׃

passages.text: He did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with all of us who are alive here today.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to all Israel.
Moses said that the LORD made a covenant at Horeb.
The LORD did not make this covenant with our ancestors.
The LORD made this covenant with us.
We are all alive here today.
passages.original: לֹ֣א אֶת־ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את כִּ֣י אִתָּ֗נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ אֵ֥לֶּה פֹ֛ה הַיּ֖וֹם כֻּלָּ֥נוּ חַיִּֽים׃

passages.text: The LORD spoke with you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD spoke with you.
He spoke directly to you.
He spoke on the mountain.
He spoke from within the fire.
passages.original: פָּנִ֣ים׀ בְּפָנִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה עִמָּכֶ֛ם בָּהָ֖ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: At that time I was standing between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD, because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. And He said: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people of Israel.
Moses stood between the LORD and the people at that time.
Moses did this to declare the word of the LORD to the people.
The people were afraid of the fire on the mountain.
The people did not go up the mountain.
The LORD spoke to the people through Moses.
The LORD said, “I am the LORD your God.
I brought you out of the land of Egypt.
I brought you out of the house of slavery.”
passages.original: אָ֠נֹכִי עֹמֵ֨ד בֵּין־ יְהוָ֤ה וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְהַגִּ֥יד לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י יְרֵאתֶם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ וְלֹֽא־ עֲלִיתֶ֥ם בָּהָ֖ר לֵאמֹֽר׃ס אָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִֽ֑ים׃

passages.text: You shall have no other gods before Me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He brought you out of Egypt.
He brought you out of the house of slavery.
You must not have any other gods before Him.
passages.original: לֹ֣א יִהְיֶ֥ה־ לְךָ֛֩ אֱלֹהִ֥֨ים אֲחֵרִ֖֜ים עַל־ פָּנָֽ֗יַ׃

passages.text: You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in the heavens above, on the earth below, or in the waters beneath.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God gave them commandments.
God said, “Do not make an idol for yourself.”
Do not make any image or statue.
Do not make anything that looks like what is in the heavens above.
Do not make anything that looks like what is on the earth below.
Do not make anything that looks like what is in the waters under the earth.

passages.text: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on their children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me, but showing loving devotion to a thousand generations of those who love Me and keep My commandments.
passages.sermon:
Do not bow down to idols.
Do not worship idols.
I am the LORD your God.
I am a jealous God.
I punish the children for the sins of their fathers.
I punish to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me.
I show love to a thousand generations.
I show love to those who love Me.
I show love to those who keep My commandments.
passages.original: לֹא־ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥֣ה לָהֶ֖ם֮ וְלֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑ם֒ כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָב֧וֹת עַל־ בָּנִ֛ים וְעַל־ שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל־ רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽ֑י׃ וְעֹ֤֥שֶׂה חֶ֖֙סֶד֙ לַֽאֲלָפִ֑֔ים לְאֹהֲבַ֖י וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֹתוֹ׃ס

passages.text: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, for the LORD will not leave anyone unpunished who takes His name in vain.
passages.sermon: The LORD is your God.\r\nDo not use the name of the LORD your God in a wrong or empty way.\r\nIf anyone uses His name in vain, the LORD will not leave that person unpunished.
passages.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת־ שֵֽׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַשָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא׃ס

passages.text: Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God has commanded you.
You must observe the Sabbath day.
You must keep the Sabbath day holy.
passages.original: שָׁמ֣֛וֹר אֶת־ י֥וֹם֩ הַשַּׁבָּ֖֨ת לְקַדְּשׁ֑֜וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖֣׀ יְהוָ֥֣ה אֱלֹהֶֽ֗יךָ׃

passages.text: Six days you shall labor and do all your work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, on which you must not do any work—neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox or donkey or any of your livestock, nor the foreigner within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest as you do.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God commands you to keep the Sabbath day holy.
You must work for six days.
You must do all your work during these six days.
The seventh day is a Sabbath.
The Sabbath belongs to the LORD your God.
You must not do any work on the Sabbath.
Your son must not work on the Sabbath.
Your daughter must not work on the Sabbath.
Your male servant must not work on the Sabbath.
Your female servant must not work on the Sabbath.
Your ox must not work on the Sabbath.
Your donkey must not work on the Sabbath.
None of your livestock must work on the Sabbath.
The foreigner who lives within your gates must not work on the Sabbath.
Your male servant must rest on the Sabbath.
Your female servant must rest on the Sabbath.
Your servants must rest just as you rest.
passages.original: שֵׁ֤֣שֶׁת יָמִ֣ים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד֮ וְעָשִׂ֖֣יתָ כָּֿל־ מְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ֒׃ וְי֙וֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜֔י שַׁבָּ֖֣ת׀ לַיהוָ֣֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֑֗יךָ לֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כָל־ מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּבִנְךָֽ־ וּבִתֶּ֣ךָ וְעַבְדְּךָֽ־ וַ֠אֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ֨ וַחֲמֹֽרְךָ֜ וְכָל־ בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗ךָ וְגֵֽרְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן יָנ֛וּחַ עַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ כָּמֽ֑וֹךָ׃

passages.text: Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. That is why the LORD your God has commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
You were a slave in the land of Egypt.
God brought you out of Egypt.
God used a mighty hand and an outstretched arm to save you.
This is why God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
passages.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֞֗ כִּ֣י־ עֶ֤֥בֶד הָיִ֣֙יתָ֙׀ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔֗יִם וַיֹּצִ֨אֲךָ֜֩ יְהוָ֤֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֤֙יךָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם֙ בְּיָ֤֥ד חֲזָקָ֖ה֙ וּבִזְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֑֔ה עַל־ כֵּ֗ן צִוְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־ י֥וֹם הַשַׁבָּֽת׃ס

passages.text: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
God gives you commands.
God gives you land.
God commands you to honor your father.
God commands you to honor your mother.
Honor your father and your mother.
If you honor your father and your mother, your days will be long.
If you honor your father and your mother, it will go well with you in the land God gives you.
passages.original: כַּבֵּ֤ד אֶת־ אָבִ֙יךָ֙ וְאֶת־ אִמֶּ֔ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן׀ יַאֲרִיכֻ֣ן יָמֶ֗יךָ וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: You shall not murder.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to His people.
God said, “You shall not murder.”
Do not kill another person.
Do not take a life.
passages.original: לֹ֥֖א תִּֿרְצָֽח׃ס

passages.text: You shall not commit adultery.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to His people.
God said, “You shall not commit adultery.”
Do not be unfaithful to your spouse.
Do not have sexual relations with someone who is not your husband or wife.
passages.original: וְלֹ֖֣א תִּֿנְאָֽ֑ף׃ס

passages.text: You shall not steal.
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments to the people of Israel.
God spoke with a loud voice from the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness on the mountain.
God said, "You shall not steal."
God wrote these commandments on two stone tablets.
God gave the tablets to Moses.
passages.original: וְלֹ֖֣א תִּֿגְנֹֽ֔ב׃ס

passages.text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments to Israel.
God spoke these commandments on the mountain.
God spoke with a loud voice.
God spoke from the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness.
God wrote the commandments on two stone tablets.
God gave the tablets to Moses.

God said, “You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.”
Do not speak lies about your neighbor.
Do not give false testimony about your neighbor.
Always speak the truth about others.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ תַעֲנֶ֥ה בְרֵֽעֲךָ֖ עֵ֥ד שָֽׁוְא׃ס

passages.text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. You shall not covet your neighbor’s house or field, or his manservant or maidservant, or his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.”
passages.sermon:
God gave commandments to His people.
God spoke these commandments to all the people from the mountain.
God spoke with a loud voice from the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness.
God wrote these commandments on two stone tablets.
God gave the tablets to Moses.
One commandment says: Do not covet your neighbor’s wife.
Do not desire your neighbor’s house.
Do not desire your neighbor’s field.
Do not desire your neighbor’s male servant.
Do not desire your neighbor’s female servant.
Do not desire your neighbor’s ox.
Do not desire your neighbor’s donkey.
Do not desire anything that belongs to your neighbor.
passages.original: וְלֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֑ךָס וְלֹ֨א תִתְאַוֶּ֜ה בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֗ךָ שָׂדֵ֜הוּ וְעַבְדּ֤וֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ֙ שׁוֹר֣וֹ וַחֲמֹר֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְרֵעֶֽךָ׃ס

passages.text: The LORD spoke these commandments in a loud voice to your whole assembly out of the fire, the cloud, and the deep darkness on the mountain; He added nothing more. And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and gave them to me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke these commandments.
He spoke to your whole assembly.
He spoke on the mountain.
He spoke out of the fire.
He spoke from the cloud.
He spoke from the deep darkness.
He spoke with a loud voice.
He added nothing more.
He wrote the commandments on two tablets of stone.
He gave the tablets to me.
passages.original: אֶֽת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־ כָּל־ קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְלֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֗ם עַל־ שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת אֲבָנִ֔ים וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃

passages.text: And when you heard the voice out of the darkness while the mountain was blazing with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your elders approached me, and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us His glory and greatness, and we have heard His voice out of the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel stood at Mount Sinai.
The mountain burned with fire.
Darkness covered the mountain.
God spoke from the darkness.
The people heard God's voice.
All the leaders of the tribes came to me.
All the elders came to me.
They said, “The LORD our God has shown us His glory.
He has shown us His greatness.
We have heard His voice from the fire.
Today we have seen this.
God can speak to a man.
The man can live.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶ֤ם אֶת־ הַקּוֹל֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַ֔י כָּל־ רָאשֵׁ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְזִקְנֵיכֶֽם׃ וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ הֵ֣ן הֶרְאָ֜נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־ כְּבֹד֣וֹ וְאֶת־ גָּדְל֔וֹ וְאֶת־ קֹל֥וֹ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ רָאִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־ יְדַבֵּ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי׃

passages.text: But now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us, and we will die, if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel stood at the mountain.
The LORD spoke to them from the fire.
The fire was very great.
The people became afraid.
They said, “Why should we die now?”
They believed the great fire would consume them.
They said, “If we keep hearing the voice of the LORD our God, we will die.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּה֙ לָ֣מָּה נָמ֔וּת כִּ֣י תֹֽאכְלֵ֔נוּ הָאֵ֥שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את אִם־ יֹסְפִ֣ים׀ אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לִ֠שְׁמֹעַ אֶת־ ק֨וֹל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ ע֖וֹד וָמָֽתְנוּ׃

passages.text: For who of all flesh has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the fire, as we have, and survived?
passages.sermon:
God is alive.
God spoke from the fire.
We heard God's voice from the fire.
We are human beings.
We survived after hearing God's voice.
No other people have heard the living God speak from the fire and lived, as we have.
passages.original: כִּ֣י מִ֣י כָל־ בָּשָׂ֡ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע קוֹל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חַיִּ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־ הָאֵ֛שׁ כָּמֹ֖נוּ וַיֶּֽחִי׃

passages.text: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then you can tell us everything the LORD our God tells you; we will listen and obey.”
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel spoke to Moses.
They were afraid to hear God's voice directly.
They said, "Moses, you go near to God."
"Listen to everything the LORD our God says."
"Then you come and tell us everything the LORD our God tells you."
"We will listen to you."
"We will obey what you say."
passages.original: קְרַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאַ֣תְּ׀ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֗ינוּ אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְדַבֵּ֜ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְשָׁמַ֥עְנוּ וְעָשִֽׂינוּ׃

passages.text: And the LORD heard the words you spoke to me, and He said to me, “I have heard the words that these people have spoken to you. They have done well in all that they have spoken.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD heard the words you spoke to me.
The LORD said to me, “I have heard the words of these people.
They spoke these words to you.
They have done well in all that they have spoken.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֔ם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־ ק֨וֹל דִּבְרֵ֜י הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבְּר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃

passages.text: If only they had such a heart to fear Me and keep all My commandments always, so that it might be well with them and with their children forever.
passages.sermon:
God spoke about the people of Israel.
God wanted them to have a certain kind of heart.
God wanted them to fear Him.
God wanted them to keep all His commandments.
God wanted them to do this always.
If they did this, it would be well with them.
It would also be well with their children forever.
passages.original: מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֡ן וְהָיָה֩ לְבָבָ֨ם זֶ֜ה לָהֶ֗ם לְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתַ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֑ים לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָהֶ֛ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְעֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Go and tell them: ‘Return to your tents.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a command.
God said, “Go to the people.”
God said, “Tell the people this message.”
God said, “Return to your tents.”
passages.original: לֵ֖ךְ אֱמֹ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם שׁ֥וּבוּ לָכֶ֖ם לְאָהֳלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: But you stand here with Me, that I may speak to you all the commandments and statutes and ordinances you are to teach them to follow in the land that I am giving them to possess.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God chose Moses as His servant and leader.
God said, “You stand here with Me.
I will speak to you now.
I will tell you all the commandments.
I will tell you all the statutes.
I will tell you all the ordinances.
You must teach these to the people.
The people must do these things.
They will do them in the land I am giving them.
I am giving this land to them to possess.”
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה פֹּה֮ עֲמֹ֣ד עִמָּדִי֒ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ אֵ֧ת כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֛ה וְהַחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּלַמְּדֵ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: So be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you; you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He has given you commands.
Be careful to do what He has commanded you.
Do not turn aside from His commands.
Do not turn to the right.
Do not turn to the left.
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶתְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תָסֻ֖רוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל׃

passages.text: You must walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD your God has given you commands.
You must follow every way that He has commanded you.
If you do this, you will live.
It will go well for you.
You will have many days in the land.
You will possess this land.
passages.original: בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם אֶתְכֶ֖ם תֵּלֵ֑כוּ לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיוּן֙ וְט֣וֹב לָכֶ֔ם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּ֣ם יָמִ֔ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽירָשֽׁוּן׃
